limitations: Requested sample workflow and three exact scripts are verified; this does not establish full native equation feature parity.
For other historical expression states only normalized visual transcripts exist; exact CF_UNICODETEXT is not invented.
WPF/custom-painted formula widgets often have no individual HWND/UIA name. Native container HWND, pointer/hotspot, GUI focus/caret and raw custom insertion cursor evidence are provided.
Installed Windows PWA window was absent, so Ctrl+R/SW-cache replacement/document restoration in that window were not tested; no cache or local storage was deleted.
Native visible work area is 1920x1040, while user supplied image was 1918x1031; paper geometry matches exactly, full screenshot cropping differs.

native_escape_semantics.changed_equation: Escape opens native prompt asking whether to insert; choices Insert(Y), Leave(N), Cancel(C). Escape at prompt cancels the prompt and returns to equation editor.
native_escape_semantics.unchanged_reedit: After template popup dismissed, Escape returned to document with equation unchanged.

timing_findings: New WPF equation HWND can become foreground before its title/content is populated; first double-click checks failed early but subsequently observed owned windows proved successful reopen. No claim that double-click itself failed.
Readiness and screenshot delay are part of reproduction; immediate historical captures remain marked timing-unverified.
